description: F7 rule 1 golden: iap.execution.sor_v2.CostAwareRouter.plan_sweep (API_TRADING.md section 2.9 / 2.13 P0-4) on fixed three-venue books (events = MarketEvent rows [event_id, instrument_id, venue_id, exchange_ts, receive_ts, sequence, event_type, side, price_ticks, qty, order_id, trade_id] applied to a ConsolidatedBook of instrument 7) and on the sampled real slice. Each query is plan_sweep(book, side, qty, ts, limit_ticks=, candidates=, tick=) under its own RouterOptions; the ledger fills are recorded before any query (tiered fees). expected children rows: [venue_id, price_ticks, qty, send_offset_ns, arrival_offset_ns]; an {error} entry means the call raised ValueError.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

fixed.label: venue 1 dear taker (fee outweighs a tick under all_in)

slice.rule: a sample is taken after applying the k-th event (1-based) whenever k > prefix_events and k % sample_every == 0
slice.queries: at every sample, in order: plan_sweep(buy 5000, price rank), (sell 5000, all_in), (buy 3000, all_in, limit best_ask + 2), (sell 800, price rank, stagger none, limit best_bid); ts = the sampled event's exchange_ts; tick = the slice tick
